issue_title: fix(public): mirror the 2026-10-11 allthingsai.org menus on the ATA parent bar
problem_statement:
fix(public): mirror the 2026-10-11 allthingsai.org menus on the ATA parent bar

Mirrors Mark's 2026-10-11 menu spec (applied to allthingsai.org `staging` in a public repository (pull request 179)) on the ATA parent bar, `src/lib/atai-site-chrome.ts`.

**Events:** Overview · Why Attend · Save the Date for ATAI 2027 (local `/events/all-things-ai-2027/save-the-date`) · Executive AI Summit · Meetups · Build an Agent Day · All Events (local `/`, the upcoming-events index). Dropped: the direct "All Things AI 2027" item, "2026 Talks", "Upcoming events".

**Get Involved:** adds Scholarships for parity with allthingsai.org.

**About:** Our Story · News · Advisory Board · The Industry · AI Skills for Work · Build the AI Future · Why the Triangle?.

**Footer, Conference column:** 2026 Conference and 2025 Conference point at this site's archives (`/events/all-things-ai-2026`, `/events/all-things-open-ai-2025`) instead of `allthingsai.org/2026` and `/2025`.

Tests updated in `tests/unit/atai-site-chrome.test.ts`. Verified: `vitest` 7/7 on that file, `tsc --noEmit` clean.

Note for the OSS cleanup lane (#2231 / #2240): on `chore/oss-cleanup` this file is replaced by tenant-configured `parentNav` data. When that lands, the ATA tenant's `parentNav` must carry this same list; tracked as a note on The-AIE/ata-events-site#15.

Not Tier C. Promote to `ata/release` after merge so events.allthingsai.org matches allthingsai.org.
